title: A fixed price at one location, the tier price at another
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use a staging client with two locations, location 1 and location 2, and a user who can work at both.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test with the same part number at both locations, in category A, cost $10.00, with a fixed sell price of $12.50 at location 1 only.
  • Have two new work orders for this test for customer A, work order 1 at location 1 and work order 2 at location 2, each with one labor line (line 1).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Add the inventory part to line 1 from the catalog search.
  3. Switch to location 2.
  4. Open work order 2.
  5. Add the same inventory part to line 1 from the catalog search.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • The part comes in at $12.50, its fixed price at location 1.

Step 3:

  • Location 2 is the current location.

Step 4:

  • Work order 2 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 5:

  • The part comes in at $12.15, tier A's price: $10.00 × 1.35 = $13.50, less 10% = $12.15.
